text.p: Cairn Energy Plc said it signed an 18-month drilling contract with Momentum Engineering for the rig "Orizont" to start operations off the Bangladesh coast.
The rig, which can be hired for another 18 months, is expected to arrive in late January for drilling of two appraisal wells, two development wells and one exploration well at the Sangu field.
"The signing of a long term contract allows Cairn to progress its planned aggressive programme of production and exploration wells offshore Bangladesh," said Cairn's chief executive Bill Gammell.
Cairn also plans to start a Bangladeshi onshore drilling programme in Febraury 1997. An appraisal drilling is planned for Block 15 of the Semutang field.
An exploration well is planned for the Halda valley near Chittagong.
